description: Get safety information for a trucking company by DOT number. Returns either CSA BASIC percentile scores (where FMCSA publishes them, rare per FAST Act 2015 restrictions) OR a public safety summary built from crash counts, fatal/injury crashes, driver/vehicle/hazmat out-of-service rates, and inspection volumes (always available). Use this for questions like 'is this carrier safe?', 'what's their safety record?', 'how many crashes?', 'should I hire this carrier?', 'check their inspection history', or any trucking safety evaluation. Higher BASIC percentiles = worse record. For OOS rates, lower is better; national averages provided for comparison.
name: fmcsa_safety_scores
